evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of chest pressure with exertion.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 77 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 182 ms, QRS 80 ms, QTc
445 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.

Transthoracic echo this admission: LVEF 45%. Trace mitral regurgitation. Mildly reduced
left ventricular systolic function.
